title: 9tz.2: SearchError typed error enum
description:
What: Create crates/reader/src/search/error.rs with SearchError enum.

Algorithm:
1. Create directory crates/reader/src/search/ with mod.rs and error.rs.
2. In error.rs define:
   #[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
   pub enum SearchError {
       #[error("tantivy error: {0}")] Tantivy(#[from] tantivy::TantivyError),
       #[error("query parse error: {0}")] QueryParse(String),
       #[error("query too long: {len} bytes, max {max}")] QueryTooLong { len: usize, max: usize },
       #[error("index not available")] Unavailable,
   }
3. In mod.rs: pub mod error; pub use error::SearchError; (rest of module added in 9tz.4)
4. In crates/reader/src/lib.rs add: pub mod search;

Defensive rules: All error variants must be non_exhaustive or have doc comments. No unwrap().

Tests: simple unit test verifying error Display messages are non-empty.
